raw_response:
I am 73 years old. I have farmed this land for 50 years since I was a young man. I only finished primary school, but I know this soil better than any book. My farm is 5.5 mu — 3 mu of cotton and 2.5 mu of stevia. It is just me and my wife now, so we cannot manage too much, but 5.5 mu is about right for two old people with a walking tractor.

For cotton, I plant guoxinmian, the improved kind with the Bt gene. I buy 2.5 jin of seed per mu from the dealer in town — the same as last year, same as my neighbor Old Zhang. Before planting around April 20th, I spread 100 jin of compound fertilizer per mu — the special kind, 20-10-21, in the red and white bag. That is 50 kilos per mu. When the cotton starts flowering in July, I top-dress with 40 jin of urea per mu. I know fertilizer is expensive — over 150 yuan per mu — but you cannot be stingy. Last year I got 500 kilos per mu, and if I cut back, the bolls will not fill. A bad harvest is a disaster; wasting some fertilizer is just money. I irrigate three times from my well — at planting, at flowering, and at boll stage. Cotton has many pests, especially bollworm, so I spray about 10 times. I use the rotary tiller before planting. I expect 500 kilos per mu this year if the rain comes right.

For stevia, I plant chengguang variety seedlings — about 8,000 plants per mu. I buy them from the dealer. I put down 100 jin of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer as base, that is 50 kilos. Then I top-dress twice, 60 jin each time, also 15-15-15. I also spread half a cart of chicken manure before planting — my wife keeps twenty chickens, so we have some. Stevia likes water, so I irrigate four times. I spray pesticides about 8 times for leaf miners and aphids. I rotary till before planting. Last year I got 500 kilos of dried leaves per mu, and the dealer paid 6.5 yuan per kilo. That is better money than cotton. I hope for 500 kilos again.

I watch what my neighbors do. Old Zhang has 4 mu next to me and uses similar amounts. If everyone around me applies 100 jin of compound, I apply 100 jin. At my age, I do not take risks. I will do what I did last year. Fertilizer costs are high, but stevia and cotton together should bring in enough for us to live and buy medicine. My son works in Handan and sends a little, but I am a farmer — I make my own living.
